title: Provider/model execution policy convergence
root_cause: Python provider execution and extension local/provider paths do not share one semantic authority, egress, cost, fallback, and evidence contract.
source_requirement: Converge policy/evidence semantics across languages without forcing one implementation language.
implementation_steps: Define shared provider execution policy schema.
Align Python and extension outcomes and violation IDs.
Require exact provider/model receipt or fail closed.
negative_cases: Fallback changes privacy or model identity.
Provider claims success without exact receipt.
affected_tests: Agent runtime, extension local/provider, model attachment tests.
evidence_required: Cross-language conformance and contained execution receipts; no billable call.
rollback: Disable converged execution entry and keep provider effects blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Both runtimes enforce the same policy semantics and stable outcomes.
No fallback or egress occurs outside the immutable plan authority.
